1. (Currently Amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations __that have incompatible filing system configurations__;
automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records __in a format-agnostic manner__, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations; and
batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations __by transforming each document into the specific format required by each respective organization's filing system__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different courts with different filing system configurations __and the method further comprises automatically detecting the filing system configuration of each court and transforming the bankruptcy documents accordingly before filing__.

6. (Currently Amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim __specific to the creditor's debt and the debtor's bankruptcy case__;
automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records __by extracting creditor-specific information and formatting it according to each bankruptcy organization's requirements__, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations; and
batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations __by submitting formatted proofs to each organization's filing system in accordance with that organization's procedural rules__.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations __and wherein the method comprises identifying each court's specific filing requirements and formatting each proof of claim accordingly__.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising sending bankruptcy notification messages to the plurality of creditors, wherein the bankruptcy notification messages __are generated from bankruptcy court filings and__ notify the creditors that various debtors have filed for bankruptcy __and provide information regarding the status of filed proofs of claims__.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests from the plurality of creditors comprises receiving the requests using a secure file transfer protocol __and validating the received data records against bankruptcy court filing requirements__.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests comprises receiving requests via a Web site __that is configured to collect creditor information and format it for bankruptcy court filing__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 where batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims __by bankruptcy organization__ and filing the proofs of claims in a batch mode at least once per day __with each respective bankruptcy organization__.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising:
generating a report __regarding the status of proofs of claims filed with bankruptcy organizations__; and
sending the report to a particular creditor __that submitted a request for filing proofs of claims__.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises enabling a user to request the report using a Web site __that displays filing status information for proofs of claims submitted by that user__.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises generating an aging report specifying a reason some proofs of claims have not been filed __with the bankruptcy organizations, including reasons related to filing system incompatibilities or validation failures__.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 further comprising receiving a filing receipt for a filed proof of claim __from the bankruptcy organization's filing system__.

16. (Previously Presented) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing is performed by a server computer.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising validating the data record __against the filing requirements of each bankruptcy organization with which the proof of claim will be filed__.
